title: Quote
description: Someone's own words, large and light, under a thin gold quotation mark that draws itself, with the name on a hairline. Optionally the speaker's photo or clip on the side, words kept off the face.

props.text: required, the person's own sentence, word for word
props.role: what they do, or where it was said
props.gold: a word or words from the text to colour gold
props.src: a photo or clip of the speaker
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face, 0 to 1
